claims: Pokémon Champions releases on April 8, 2026, for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.
Pokémon Champions is a free-to-start, competitive-focused arena battler.
Pokémon Champions is developed by The Pokémon Works.
Reports suggest a June 2026 launch for the mobile version of Pokémon Champions for iOS and Android.
The focus of Pokémon Champions is competitive VGC battling.
The official site of Pokémon Champions is champions.pokemon.com.
As of April 8, 2026, Pokémon Champions is officially launching.
